question_en: An F-29.04 input trend changes gradually over time. Which evidence is most useful for evaluating signal integrity?
options: Trend analysis together with process parameters and field-device test results.
explanation_en: F-29.04 identifies input-signal trend analysis and verification against process parameters as maintenance evidence.
explanation_es: F-29.04 identifica el análisis de tendencias y la verificación contra parámetros de proceso como evidencia de mantenimiento.

question_en: An F-29.04 output value does not agree with the expected process response. What should be verified before concluding the control logic is wrong?
options: I/O device condition, signal integrity, polarity/calibration and operation against process parameters.
explanation_en: F-29 requires verification of connection/polarity, calibration and device operation against process parameters.
explanation_es: F-29 exige verificar conexión/polaridad, calibración y operación del dispositivo contra parámetros de proceso.

question_en: A calibrated F-29.04 input later shows drift. Which combination of records best supports diagnosis?
options: Signal trend plus as-found/as-left calibration information and current field-test results.
explanation_en: F-29.04 links signal-trend review, field-device testing, calibration and as-found/as-left documentation.
explanation_es: F-29.04 relaciona revisión de tendencias, pruebas del dispositivo, calibración y documentación as-found/as-left.
